name: Silent dark trading-terminal reveal: power-on from a dot, camera tour of the panels, collapse to a star and regrow

source.location: external: user reference folder (resolve with --root or MOTION_REFERENCE_ROOTS); never copied into the repository
source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: Product wordmark and tagline on the end card
Trading terminal and mobile trading interface

rights.notes: Rights unverified. Trading platform launch; reuse the power-on, camera-tour and collapse-and-regrow principles only, with an original interface.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session F) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (63 frames) and transitions strips at the 4 boundaries (every 2nd frame); strips at 3.20-5.80 s (10 fps), 25.60-27.40 s and 35.20-37.20 s (15 fps). No listen sheet or audio panel (no audio track); nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 47.0 s (1280x720, 29.96 fps); the power-on, the collapse and the regrow at 10-15 fps.

concept.observed: A launch reveal for a trading terminal: a pulsing dot powers on into the interface, the camera tours the chart, a macro of the candles, the order book and an options payoff chart, then the terminal shrinks to a point that becomes a star, stars converge back to a point, and a device-sized version of the terminal grows out of it for an order and the end card.
concept.interpreted: Desktop to mobile told as one continuous object that collapses and re-forms.

communication_style.observed: Silent; no copy except interface labels and a small tagline over the wordmark at the end.

palette.observed: Black (#080808, 56%) and very dark navy; teal-green and red candles, a bright teal price tag, faint violet and red nebula colour in the starfield.

typography.observed: Interface type only: small grotesque labels and tabular prices; a large blurred price tag in the macro shots; a light wordmark and tagline at the end.

camera.observed: Continuous virtual camera: push into the chart (11.5-13.8 s), macro on the candles with shallow depth of field and bokeh (13.8-17.0 s), pull back to the order book (17.1-18.3 s), options panel (21-23.5 s), pull back to the whole terminal (24-25.7 s).

motion.observed: Dot pulses (0-3.4 s); a line grows across the frame (3.7-4.3 s), opens into a band (4.4 s) and then the frame (4.5-4.8 s); panels draw in one by one (5.3-11 s); the price tag ticks; the terminal shrinks to a small box over about 1.7 s, accelerating (25.7-27.4 s); a starfield drifts (28-35 s); stars converge to a point (35.2-35.6 s) and a device screen grows from it over about 1.5 s (35.7-37.2 s); an order ticket slides in and confirms (38.4-40.7 s).

transitions.observed: No cuts. The 4 soft boundaries (13.42, 14.42, 15.42, 17.08 s) are inside the macro camera move (depth-of-field shifts). The real changes are continuous: a power-on from a dot through a line (3.5-4.8 s, the reverse of a CRT collapse), a camera tour, a shrink to a point (25.7-27.4 s) that becomes a star, and a regrow from a point (35.2-37.2 s).
transitions.interpreted: Every change is a camera move or a change of scale of the same object; the act break (desktop to mobile) is a collapse to a point and a regrow, not a cut.

depth_and_layering.observed: Macro shots (13.8-17 s) have shallow depth of field, glowing nodes and dot-matrix glass candle bodies: they read as rendered 3D rather than flat interface.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Slow: 3.4 s of a lone dot, about 6 s of panel build, 14 s of camera tour, 8 s of starfield drift, then 10 s of mobile and end card.

sound_design.observed: No audio track (ffprobe: one H.264 video stream).
sound_design.interpreted: A silent film: rhythm is carried by motion and holds alone.

captions.observed: No captions or headlines; interface labels only, and a small centred tagline over the wordmark (42.9-46.6 s).

scenes.observed: The dot becomes a line, a band and the frame.
The terminal builds panel by panel.
Camera tour: chart push, candle macro, order book, options payoff, pull back.
The terminal shrinks to a point that becomes a star; starfield drift.
Stars converge; a device screen grows from the point; an order is placed.

moments.observed: After the dot vanishes, a hairline grows across the frame (3.7-4.3 s), opens into a band (4.4 s) and then into the full interface frame (4.5-4.8 s).
moments.interpreted: A power-on: the interface is switched on rather than cut to.

difficult: The candle macro with depth of field and glass materials looks like a 3D render (Blender plate or WebGL)
The starfield with nebula colour needs many soft particles; heavy as filtered DOM layers at 720p
uncertainties: Whether the film was published silent or the audio was stripped before it reached us
Easing of the shrink and regrow (10-15 fps strips only)
Whether the macro shots are rendered 3D or 2.5D layers with blur

sampling.cut_refinement: every frame inside the coarse step
